result.summary: Found 4 issues, mainly related to content clipping and horizontal scroll layout at the screen edge, plus a cut-off restaurant name.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating horizontal overflow not clearly designed as a scrollable carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible edge fade or partial card preview indicator to signal horizontal scrolling, or ensure cards are fully visible with proper padding.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated with no ellipsis or clear indication of cut-off text.
issues.suggestion: Use ellipsis (...) for truncated text or ensure enough card width to display full name.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears to have another category partially cut off at the right edge, similar to the restaurant card issue.
issues.suggestion: Add scroll affordance (fade gradient or arrow) to indicate more filter options are available.

issues.description: The second promotional card (pizza with -20% discount) at the bottom is abruptly cut off by the navigation bar, making it look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing or scroll padding so cards are not awkwardly cut by the bottom navigation, or add fade-out effect.
